title: Implement Secure Authentication System
problem_statement: Current VB6 login form lacks modern security practices including password hashing, secure session management, and multi-factor authentication
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking system, credential theft, regulatory compliance violations
suggested_approach: Replace VB6 login with OAuth2/JWT-based authentication service, implement bcrypt password hashing, add session timeout controls
success_criteria: All passwords stored with bcrypt hashing
Failed login attempt lockout after 3 tries
Audit trail for all authentication events

title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: ADO data access layer likely uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating injection attack vectors
risk_if_unaddressed: Database compromise, unauthorized data access, data corruption or deletion
suggested_approach: Replace ADO with parameterized queries using modern ORM, implement stored procedures for sensitive operations, add query validation
success_criteria: All database queries use parameterized statements
Penetration testing passes for injection attacks

title: Add Comprehensive Input Validation
problem_statement: Form controls lack client-side and server-side validation for financial data integrity
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid transactions, data corruption, business logic bypass, regulatory compliance issues
suggested_approach: Implement validation middleware with business rule engine, add client-side validation for UX, create validation schemas for all financial operations
success_criteria: All monetary inputs validated for format and range
Account number validation with check digits
Transaction limits enforced at API level
Validation error messages user-friendly and logged

title: Establish Agent Framework Testing Strategy
problem_statement: Modernization agent framework lacks unit tests, integration tests, and banking domain validation
risk_if_unaddressed: Unreliable modernization process, potential data loss during migration, extended development timeline
suggested_approach: Implement pytest-based testing with banking transaction test scenarios, add integration tests for agent workflows, create test data fixtures
success_criteria: 90% code coverage for all agent modules
Integration tests for complete modernization workflows
Automated test execution in CI/CD pipeline
